evals.name: reads-a-large-page-through-the-lookup
evals.prompt: What does the official Claude Code hooks docs page say about the exit code a PreToolUse hook uses to block a tool call? Read the page itself, not a summary.
evals.expected_output: Fetches the hooks page with fetch-docs.sh --cache, reads it with docs-cache.sh read, sees a section map because the page is over the whole-page threshold, slices the sections about exit codes and PreToolUse, and answers from the sliced text with section ids cited and a currency line giving the URL, format and validated time. It does not answer from a WebFetch extraction.
expectations: The page is fetched with fetch-docs.sh using --cache, not with WebFetch
docs-cache.sh read is run on the cache_key from the fetch manifest before any slice
docs-cache.sh slice is run with the ids of the sections the answer cites, chosen by the model from the map
The answer cites the section ids or heading paths its claims come from
The answer closes with a currency line naming the URL, the format and the validated time or age

evals.name: page-silent-on-the-asked-fact
evals.prompt: Using the Claude Code hooks docs page, tell me the maximum number of hooks Claude Code allows per event. Only use what the page says.
evals.expected_output: Reads the hooks page through the lookup, finds no stated per-event hook limit in the sections it read, and answers with 'not stated on the page' for that fact. Any guess about a limit appears only in a separate part labeled 'Inference (not from the page)', never in the page-backed answer. A note stored afterwards carries the 'not stated on the page' marking and no inference.
expectations: The page-backed answer states 'not stated on the page' for the per-event hook limit
No number for the limit appears in the page-backed part of the answer
Any inference or outside knowledge about a limit is in a separate part labeled 'Inference (not from the page)'
If a note is stored, its text keeps 'not stated on the page' and contains no inference

evals.name: verification-reads-raw-bytes-only
evals.prompt: Verify against the live docs that the settings page still documents the permissions.deny key. Do not trust anything cached from earlier sessions.
evals.expected_output: Fetches the settings page with fetch-docs.sh --cache --max-age 0 and reads it with docs-cache.sh read --raw or slice, never with a plain read that would print stored notes and summaries. The verdict rests on the raw page text.
expectations: The page is read with read --raw or slice, and no stored note or summary is used as evidence
The verdict quotes or cites the raw section text it rests on
